title: Sajjad ki tanhai
body:
Sajjad ki tanhai , sajdon ko rulati thi
Zainab ki sakina ki , rudad sunati thi
1 jab pyaas satati thi , sarwar ke yateemon ko
Paani tou na milta tha , us baali sakina ko
Par mou pe tamache wo , har gaam pa khaati thi
2 kaise main bataunga , guzri joh mere dil par
Bazaar me jis lamha barsaye Gaye patthar
Sar hathon se kis tarah , har bibi chupati thi
3 talwar dikha ke wo , har 1 ko darata the
Rota tha agar koi tou naiza chubate the
Is waste har bibi ashkon ko chupati thi
4 kya kya na sitam aqir tute hain sakina par
Khati thi kabhi durre khati thi kabhi patthar
Har zulm pe wo bacchi, ghazi ko bulati thi
5 jab jab bhi sataya tha, zainab ko sitamger ne
Jab jab bhi rulaya tha , Zainab ko sitamger ne
Hasrath se saare Ghazi, bas takti hi jaati thi
6 zalim ne giraya tha , jiswaqt saare sarwar
Aur haske girate the , jis waqt saare Akbar
Zainab bhi wohi khudko , mehmil se girati thi
Nasir ne kaha Rokar hasrat hai yehi Dil ki
Noha ye mere moula, turbat pe padhun teri
Jab tak na padha noha , ye bath satati thi
